<!-- Data report for the compiled {{SPECIES_NAME}} dataset. Modelled on SI-Text-1-data. It
describes and validates the data that go into the model: spatial coverage, sampling through
time and depth, the response distribution, trawl parameters, and length composition. Do NOT
hard-wrap prose. Raster maps use fig-format jpeg to keep the HTML small. -->

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
source(here::here("R", "00_setup.R"))
dt <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "compiled-data.rds"))
```

## Overview

Compiled bottom-trawl data for **{{SPECIES_NAME}}** (*{{SPECIES_LATIN}}*): number of stations,
years, surveys, and the share of zero-catch stations (true absences).

```{r overview}
dt |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    stations = dplyr::n(),
    years    = paste0(min(startyear), "–", max(startyear)),
    surveys  = dplyr::n_distinct(cruiseseries),
    zero_pct = round(100 * mean(rho_biomass == 0), 1)
  )
```

## Station map

```{r map}
sp <- dt |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(longitudestart), !is.na(latitudestart))
ggOceanMaps::basemap(data = sp, bathymetry = TRUE) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(
    data = sp,
    ggplot2::aes(x = longitudestart, y = latitudestart, colour = rho_biomass > 0),
    size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey60", "red"),
                               labels = c("absent", "present"), name = NULL)
```

## Sampling through time and depth

```{r effort}
dt |>
  dplyr::count(startyear, present = rho_biomass > 0) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(startyear, n, fill = present)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Stations", fill = "Caught")
```

```{r depth}
ggplot2::ggplot(dt, ggplot2::aes(depth)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Bottom depth (m)", y = "Stations")
```

## Response distribution

```{r response}
dt |>
  dplyr::filter(rho_biomass > 0) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(rho_biomass)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_log10() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = expression(paste("Biomass density (kg ", nmi^-2, "), positive stations")),
                y = "Stations")
```

## Trawl parameters

Sanity-check the swept-area inputs (haul distance, and — where recorded — duration, door
spread, wire-to-depth ratio). Outliers here distort the density.

```{r trawl}
ggplot2::ggplot(dt, ggplot2::aes(distance)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Haul distance (nmi)", y = "Stations")
```
